# Ubiquiti UniFi Switch Pro XG 10 PoE — 10-Port 10GbE Layer 3 PoE+++ Switch

**Category:** Networking gear (Switch)

**MSRP:** $699.00 (400W)

## Notable Features

- 10 multi-gigabit RJ45 ports (up to 10G) all supporting PoE+++ (up to 90W/port), plus 2x 10G SFP+ uplinks
- Full Layer 3 routing (static routing, inter-VLAN routing, DHCP server/relay) in addition to advanced Layer 2 switching
- Etherlighting™ ports illuminate to show port location, speed/link, and native VLAN/network at a glance
- 1.3" touchscreen with AR-assisted switch management via the UniFi app
- Broad Pro AV protocol support (Dante, Q-SYS, NDI, SDVoE, Shure, AES67, Crestron) for AV-over-IP deployments
- DC power backup support (via USP RPS) for redundancy
- Rugged SGCC steel construction rated for ±30kV ESD/EMP protection
